description_en: This API updates the configuration of a data migration or data synchronization task
description_zh: 本接口用于更新数据迁移或数据同步任务的配置
kebab_example: aliyun oceanbasepro update-project-config --id np_fe0000 --common-transfer-config SinkStoreFormat=example-string SourceStoreFormat=example-string --full-transfer-config MaxConcurrentIndexDDLs=1 ThrottleIOPS=1 ReadWorkerNum=64 ThrottleRps=1 WriteWorkerNum=64 IndexDDLConcurrencyLimit=1 --incr-transfer-config '{"SupportDDLTypes":["CREATE_TABLE"],"ThrottleIOPS":1,"ThrottleRps":1,"RecordTypeWhiteList":["INSERT"],"IncrSyncThreadCount":64}' --reverse-incr-transfer-config '{"SupportDDLTypes":["CREATE_TABLE"],"ThrottleIOPS":1,"ThrottleRps":1,"RecordTypeWhiteList":["INSERT"],"IncrSyncThreadCount":64}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateProjectConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization project
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移或数据同步项目的 ID
parameters.name: id

fields.help_en: The maximum transfer rate for the full data transfer phase, in records per second (RPS). If you set this parameter to `null`, the RPS is not limited
fields.help_zh: 全量传输阶段限制能达到的最大传输速率，单位为记录数/秒。输入 null 时，表示不限制 RPS
fields.name: throttle_rps

fields.help_en: The maximum I/O operations per second (IOPS) for the full data transfer phase. If you set this parameter to `null`, the IOPS are not limited
fields.help_zh: 全量传输阶段限制能达到的最大传输流量，单位为字节/秒。输入 null 时，表示不限制 IOPS
fields.name: throttle_iops

parameters.help_en: The settings for full data transfer
parameters.name: full_transfer_config

fields.help_en: The number of threads for incremental data transfer
fields.name: incr_sync_thread_count

fields.help_en: The maximum transfer rate for the incremental data transfer phase, in records per second (RPS). If you set this parameter to `null`, the RPS is not limited
fields.help_zh: 增量传输阶段限制能达到的最大传输速率，单位为记录数/秒。输入 null 时，表示不限制 RPS
fields.name: throttle_rps

fields.help_en: The maximum I/O operations per second (IOPS) for the incremental data transfer phase. If you set this parameter to `null`, the IOPS are not limited
fields.help_zh: 增量传输阶段限制能达到的最大传输流量，单位为字节/秒。输入 null 时，表示不限制 IOPS
fields.name: throttle_iops

fields.help_en: The types of incremental data to synchronize during the incremental data transfer phase
fields.help_zh: 有增量同步阶段时，同步的增量数据类型
fields.name: record_type_white_list

fields.help_en: The DDL types to synchronize during the incremental data transfer phase
fields.name: support_ddl_types

parameters.help_en: The settings for incremental data transfer
parameters.name: incr_transfer_config

fields.help_en: The number of threads for reverse incremental data transfer
fields.help_zh: 反向增量传输的线程数
fields.name: incr_sync_thread_count

fields.help_en: The maximum transfer rate for the reverse incremental data transfer phase, in records per second (RPS). If you set this parameter to `null`, the RPS is not limited
fields.help_zh: 反向增量传输阶段限制能达到的最大传输速率，单位为记录数/秒。输入 null 时，表示不限制 RPS
fields.name: throttle_rps

fields.help_en: The maximum I/O operations per second (IOPS) for the reverse incremental data transfer phase. If you set this parameter to `null`, the IOPS are not limited
fields.help_zh: 反向增量传输阶段限制能达到的最大传输流量，单位为字节/秒。输入 null 时，表示不限制 IOPS
fields.name: throttle_iops

fields.help_en: The types of incremental data to synchronize during the reverse incremental data transfer phase
fields.help_zh: 有增量同步阶段时，同步的增量数据类型
fields.name: record_type_white_list

fields.help_en: The DDL types to synchronize during the reverse incremental data transfer phase
fields.help_zh: 反向增量传输阶段支持的 DDL 类型
fields.name: support_ddl_types

parameters.help_en: The settings for reverse incremental data transfer
parameters.name: reverse_incr_transfer_config
